about: Jev (TypeSafe System One) as a second opinion on Narada's routing, measured on the Pi 5 on 2026-10-18 with scripts/jev_eval.py. Sets: tests/eval/routing_cases.json (50, hand-written) and the odd (test) half of tests/eval/routing_written.json (717, NIM-written, known label noise on paraphrases).
jev_latency_ms_from_pi: about 370-520 per call (4 choice questions, about 508 input tokens)
reading: Jev routes worse than the router trained for this, and is far more often 'other' on paraphrases. As an independent check it removes the router's confident mistakes: agreement with both sure was wrong 0 times in 767, so that is the fast lane's rule.
